rows.selection_reason: The existing evidence is empty, so the first experiment should establish a baseline. This tests a simple rna_only model with pca_n2000 encoder and singleprofile setting, which isolates the effect of the rna_encoder and profile_setting. It clarifies whether basic rna-only models can achieve reasonable performance, providing foundational insights for future comparisons.

The existing evidence shows that RNA-only singleprofile with pca_n2000 achieves 0.4849 accuracy. This experiment tests multiprofile with avgpool aggregation (same RNA encoder, no image encoder), isolating the impact of profile setting and aggregation. It balances exploration of multiprofile (potentially capturing more data) and exploitation of a simple change from no aggregation to avgpool, which could improve performance without overcomplicating the model.

Existing evidence shows multiprofile RNA-only models (config_002) outperform singleprofile (config_001). This experiment tests whether switching the RNA encoder from pca_n2000 to scvi_n200 (a more sophisticated latent space model) with the same multiprofile and avgpool aggregation improves accuracy. It isolates the effect of RNA encoder choice while maintaining the proven multiprofile setup, balancing exploitation of prior success with exploration of a key design choice.

The existing evidence shows that RNA-only models with scvi_n200 encoder and avgpool aggregation achieve 0.65 accuracy. This experiment tests combining RNA and image data (multimodal) using scvi_n200 and resnet50, with avgpool (proven effective for RNA) and concat fusion (to isolate modality interaction effects). It balances exploration of multimodal benefits with leveraging prior RNA success.

Existing evidence shows that RNA-only multiprofile with scvi_n200 encoder (config_005) achieves 0.65 accuracy, the highest so far. This experiment tests whether replacing avgpool aggregation with transformer aggregation (config_006) improves performance, isolating the effect of aggregation method. It directly extends the promising scvi_n200 multiprofile direction while exploring a key design choice with minimal additional complexity.

Existing evidence shows rna_only models with scvi_n200 and transformer aggregation achieve high accuracy (0.652970). This experiment tests combining scvi_n200 with a stronger image encoder (imagenet_vit_l) and weighted fusion, which could improve performance by leveraging both modalities. It isolates the effect of image encoder quality and fusion method, addressing key uncertainties about multimodal benefits.

The existing evidence shows that multimodal models with scvi_n200 RNA encoder and resnet50 image encoder (config_033) achieve the highest validation accuracy (0.713). This experiment tests replacing resnet50 with imagenet_vit_l image encoder while maintaining scvi_n200 RNA encoder and weighted fusion, to isolate the impact of the image encoder's architecture. This is the best use of the remaining budget as it directly compares a stronger image encoder (ViT) against the current best, with minimal changes to other components.

The existing evidence shows that multimodal models with scvi_n200 RNA encoder, weighted fusion, and resnet50 image encoder (config_033) achieve the highest accuracy so far (0.713). This experiment tests replacing resnet50 with the more powerful imagenet_vit_l image encoder and switching aggregation from avgpool to transformer, which could further improve performance. It isolates the effect of the image encoder and aggregation method while retaining the effective fusion strategy, balancing exploration of key design choices with building on the current best configuration.

The existing evidence shows that multimodal models with scvi_n200 RNA encoder, imagenet_vit_l image encoder, transformer aggregation, and weighted fusion (config_039) achieve the highest accuracy (0.724989). This experiment tests whether switching the RNA encoder to scgpt (a more advanced model) while keeping other components the same could further improve performance. It directly addresses the uncertainty around the RNA encoder's impact on accuracy, leveraging the strong foundation of the current top configuration.

The existing evidence shows that multimodal models with scvi_n200 RNA encoder, imagenet_vit_l image encoder, transformer aggregation, and weighted fusion (config_039) achieve the highest accuracy so far (0.725). This experiment tests scgpt RNA encoder with the same image encoder and weighted fusion but avgpool aggregation, isolating the impact of aggregation type. It balances exploitation (using proven image encoder and fusion) with exploration (testing a different RNA encoder and aggregation) to determine if these changes could surpass the current best.
